source_quotes: never add model confidence/importance scores; judgments are yes/no via the strength-N loop
overlap_check: Extends draft 01 with how to retire a persisted confidence field without breaking old data. Add-only; related to draft 24 (confirm ambiguous revert direction).

add_heuristics.condition: an older version still carries the removed field
add_heuristics.action: never restore it from the older version

add_decision_rules.name: Retire by making it read-only legacy
add_decision_rules.condition: a persisted field contradicts the doctrine, such as confidence
add_decision_rules.outcome: delete it from the live types; where stored rows still carry it, keep reading it but never write it, so readers of serialized output see it absent

add_decision_rules.name: Remove written constants
add_decision_rules.condition: code writes a constant such as one in place of a real value
add_decision_rules.outcome: remove the write; absence is honest and a constant is a fabricated measurement
